SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffect.en: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.
SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffect.fr: La SUPER REPOUSSE empêche les\nPOKéMON plus faibles d'apparaître.\pLa SUPER REPOUSSE reste efficace\nplus longtemps que la REPOUSSE.

SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly.en: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!
SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly.fr: Le RAPPEL coûte cher, mais il\nranime les POKéMON K.O. !
